close_reason: Moot: basalt deleted in commit 1a67f0d2; the waitlist-timeout defect lived in basalt/logic.ex which no longer exists.
description: logic.ex:118 discards the timeout returned by WaitingList.insert; the server never sets a GenServer timeout and nothing calls WaitingList expiry — waitlisted fetch deadlines (30s) are inert. Clients now get notified on apply (bedrock-g1r fixed), but entries for keys that never arrive linger until client-side call timeout and are never expired server-side. Wire deadline expiry (mirror whatever olivine does, or GenServer timeout). Split from bedrock-g1r.
title: Basalt waitlist deadline expiry never wired up
